cohort: The study comprised an analysis of national live birth data from 2019 in Brazil, linked with socioeconomic indices derived from 2017 census information.
finding: Higher rates of spontaneous preterm birth were observed in areas with lower education levels and unequal income distribution, while elective preterm birth was positively associated with more advantaged socioeconomic status.
cross-section timing: Live births from 2019; socioeconomic data from 2017.
